n_jobs: <int> Number of jobs to be processed through the flow shop.
n_machines: <int> Number of machines arranged in series that every job must visit.
processing_times: <list[list[int]], shape [n_machines][n_jobs]> Time required for each machine to process each job.
due_dates: <list[int], length n_jobs> Latest allowable completion time on the last machine for each job.
